title: Shine Bright Lich a Diamond
description: Literally just retextures Glow Lichen to be Diamond Ore, inspired by a recent PhoenixSC video.
body:
**Shine Bright Lich a Diamond** is a pack which literally just changes Glow Lichen to look like Diamond Ore. It was inspired both by [u/Pixivic455's post on r/PhoenixSC](https://www.reddit.com/r/PhoenixSC/comments/1mzedt5/recent_video_gave_me_an_idea_to_retexture_glow/) and by a recent PhoenixSC video, which you can see below.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/31Xkn61PF8w" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>


This pack deviates from u/Pixivic455's version because theirs includes some of the surrounding pixels in the sprite, making it look less ideal in general while still keeping accuracy on stone and deepslate. I specifically wanted to make it look good across every block it could ever possibly appear on, and also on blocks it doesn't appear on in the base game, which is why I made this alteration.
